overall: The AG found the Lenox Housing Authority Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the videographer was not denied access, and moving the meeting to a smaller office after disorderly crowd talk was appropriate.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board denied a videographer access to the July 13 meeting by a locked door before the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, there is no allegation that the door in question was locked or otherwise inaccessible during the meeting or even shortly beforehand; rather, the videographer encountered the locked door half an hour before the meeting was scheduled to begin and then left the building.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board moved its July 13 meeting mid-meeting to an office too small to accommodate everyone in attendance.
allegations.key_passage: only a few individuals chose to follow the Board to that location and they were adequately accommodated in the smaller location.
